response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) as num_telescopes FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: "High bandwidth usage using 47.6 as the cutoff" means bandusagepct >= 47.6 (inclusive). A cutoff in filtering contexts typically includes the boundary value.

alternatives.interpretation: "Cutoff" could mean strictly greater than: bandusagepct > 47.6 (excluding telescopes at exactly 47.6)
